title: The Biflavonoid Agathisflavone Regulates Microglial and Astrocytic Inflammatory Profiles via Glucocorticoid Receptor.
authors: Almeida, Aurea Maria Alves Nunes; Santos, Cleonice Creusa Dos; Takahashi, Daniele; da Silva, Larissa Pereira; de Sousa, Veronica Moreira; de Santana, Monique Reis; Del Arco, Ana Elisa; Dos Santos, Balbino Lino; David, Jorge Mauricio; da Silva, Victor Diogenes Amaral; Braga-de-Souza, Suzana; Costa, Silvia Lima
one_liner_zh: 该文研究双黄酮化合物通过糖皮质激素受体调节胶质细胞炎症，仅含分子对接表征配体-受体结合，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Nuclear receptors such as glucocorticoid receptors (GRs) are transcription factors with prominent regulatory effects on neuroinflammation. Agathisflavone is a biflavonoid that demonstrates neurogenic, neuroprotective, anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and pro-myelinogenic effects in vitro. This study investigated whether the control of glial reactivity by agathisflavone is mediated by GRs. Primary cultures of astrocytes and microglia were induced to neuroinflammation by lipopolysaccharides (LPSs) and exposed to agathisflavone or not in the presence or absence of mifepristone, a GR antagonist. The microglia morphology and reactivity were evaluated by immunofluorescence against calcium-binding ionized adapter (Iba-1) and CD68. The astrocyte morphology and reactivity were evaluated by immunofluorescence against glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP). The inflammatory profile was evaluated by RT-qPCR. Molecular docking was performed to characterize agathisflavone and GR interactions. Microglial branching was increased in response to agathisflavone, an effect that was inhibited by mifepristone. CD68 and GFAP expression was decreased by agathisflavone but not in the presence of mifepristone. Agathisflavone decreased the expression of the pro-inflammatory cytokine IL-1beta and increased the expression of the regulatory cytokine IL-10. The increase in IL-10 mRNA was inhibited by the GR antagonist. The in silico analysis showed that agathisflavone binds to a pocket at the glucocorticoid receptor. These interactions were stronger than mifepristone, dexamethasone, and the agathisflavone monomer apigenin. These results indicate that the GR is involved in the regulatory effects of agathisflavone on microglia and astrocyte inflammation, contributing to the elucidation of the molecular mechanisms of agathisflavone's effects in the nervous system.
abstract_zh: 核受体如糖皮质激素受体（GRs）是转录因子，对神经炎症具有显著调节作用。Agathisflavone是一种双黄酮类化合物，在体外表现出神经发生、神经保护、抗炎、抗氧化和促髓鞘形成效应。本研究探讨了agathisflavone对胶质细胞反应性的控制是否由GRs介导。通过脂多糖（LPSs）诱导星形胶质细胞和小胶质细胞的原代培养产生神经炎症，并在存在或不存在GR拮抗剂米非司酮的情况下，暴露或不暴露于agathisflavone。通过针对钙结合离子化适配器（Iba-1）和CD68的免疫荧光评估小胶质细胞形态和反应性。通过针对胶质纤维酸性蛋白（GFAP）的免疫荧光评估星形胶质细胞形态和反应性。通过RT-qPCR评估炎症谱。进行分子对接以表征agathisflavone与GR的相互作用。小胶质细胞分支在agathisflavone作用下增加，此效应被米非司酮抑制。CD68和GFAP表达被agathisflavone降低，但在米非司酮存在时未降低。Agathisflavone降低了促炎细胞因子IL-1β的表达，并增加了调节性细胞因子IL-10的表达。IL-10 mRNA的增加被GR拮抗剂抑制。计算机模拟分析显示，agathisflavone结合于糖皮质激素受体的一个口袋。这些相互作用强于米非司酮、地塞米松及agathisflavone单体芹菜素。这些结果表明，GR参与agathisflavone对小胶质细胞和星形胶质细胞炎症的调节作用，有助于阐明agathisflavone在神经系统中效应的分子机制。
